source: tests/integration.test.ts: claw authenticated request budgets / keeps authenticated machine reads, play receipts and bootstrap within the PR 4 main costs

environment.database: isolated local D1/workerd per checkout; no remote production access

commands.baseline: In a detached worktree at 2f20512 with the same test-only fixture: FREE_PLAN_CLAW_MEASUREMENTS=/tmp/yegoom-pr5-claw-before.json XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/yegoom-config npm test -- tests/integration.test.ts -t "keeps authenticated machine reads, play receipts and bootstrap"
commands.after: FREE_PLAN_CLAW_MEASUREMENTS=/tmp/yegoom-pr5-claw-after.json XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/yegoom-config npm test -- tests/integration.test.ts -t "keeps authenticated machine reads, play receipts and bootstrap"
commands.regression: Without FREE_PLAN_CLAW_MEASUREMENTS the same test rejects any prepares/queries/bindingCalls/rowsRead/rowsWritten increase over before.
commands.historicalBootstrap: The existing "bounds authenticated polling queries and rows as historical ledgers grow" test remains in npm run check and protects the 12 bootstrap samples against the unchanged PR 2 baseline. These eight new samples use empty prior ledgers.

fixture.sequence: Authenticated min: bootstrap without account, first machine creation, existing machine read, bootstrap, fixed seed=1 generation=1 30-doll board and payout_every=1, new play at x=.23/stop=null, exact saved retry, machine read, bootstrap. The SQL fixture forces the existing guaranteed strong-grip configuration so reward writes are measured deterministically; app/server rules are unchanged.
fixture.serverContractAssertions: New play spends one free coin and increments version once; returned prizes/final board match simulateAttempt with the authoritative grip; gold and score match the saved response and bootstrap; retry returns identical result without another write; one play receipt and balanced append-only ledgers.
fixture.writes: Only first machine initialization and the new rewarded play write in this fixture. Bootstrap, existing reads and the stored retry write zero rows.

counting.queries: Executed SQL statements, including each statement inside DB.batch
counting.bindingCalls: Each all/first/run call or one DB.batch call
counting.rowsRead: Sum of actual D1 result.meta.rows_read; authentication included
counting.rowsWritten: Sum of actual D1 result.meta.rows_written; includes trigger/index effects

comparison.scope: PR 5 changes browser layout/rendering/replay scheduling. Worker, SQL, HTTP routes, odds, rewards and bootstrap polling remain unchanged; local fixture counts do not claim production Worker CPU timing.
